status: runtime DATA texture (a mask; root CLAUDE.md: data textures are exempt from the Codex rule, processing is not authoring) derived deterministically from the shipped ordinary zombie body GLBs (their meshes, skinning weights and embedded base-colour atlases); no image or model generation; unapproved prototype, no licence or commercial clearance implied beyond the source models' own status

output.channels: RGB (8-bit, linear data: load with NoColorSpace, flipY = false like the glTF UVs)
output.layout: 2 x 2 tiles of 512²; each body = one channel (R, G, B) of one tile; alpha deliberately unused (premultiplied-alpha uploads would wipe RGB where alpha is 0); tile [1, 1] free

method.grid: 1024² classification in the mesh's TEXCOORD_0 space (texel centres), feathered (Gaussian sigma 1 px at 1024 inside each UV island) and downsampled 2x2 (coverage-normalised) to 512²; island values dilated 4 px (at 512) into empty UV gutters, never over another island
method.regions: per-texel skinning-weight prior: Root->pelvis, Hips->pelvis, Spine->spine, Chest->chest, Neck->neck, Head->head, L_UpperArm->upperArm, R_UpperArm->upperArm, L_Forearm->forearm, R_Forearm->forearm, L_Hand->hand, R_Hand->hand, L_Thigh->thigh, R_Thigh->thigh, L_Shin->shin, R_Shin->shin, L_Foot->foot, R_Foot->foot
method.colour: CIE Lab; skin Gaussian from seed-region texels (median/MAD 2.5 trim, then two Mahalanobis-3 trims, lightness axis stretched) vs a k-means (k=12, 40000 seeded samples) Gaussian mixture of the atlas, clusters within "drop" of the skin model removed; posterior = prior-weighted likelihood ratio, cut beyond dMax
method.cleanup: inside each UV island only: Gaussian smoothing (sigma 1.5 px) + 0.5 threshold, skin specks < minSkin px removed, enclosed non-skin holes <= maxHole px filled, skin components enclosed in non-skin (>= 0.75 of their outline) and <= enclosedMax px removed, islands < 40 px take their majority
method.coverage: surface = 3D-area-weighted mean of the 512 tile sampled bilinearly at 4 interior points of every triangle (what the shader sees); uv = mean over covered 1024 texels

limits: Heuristic segmentation (colour + skinning-weight region prior + UV-island clean-up), checked by eye on atlas overlays and bind-pose CPU renders, not hand-painted: expect a few px of error along skin / cloth borders inside an island and on tiny Meshy fragments.
Mask resolution is 512² per body (half the 1024² base colour); edges are feathered ~1 px at 512.

Mipmaps would bleed neighbouring tiles (other bodies) at low levels: sample with a linear filter and no (or capped) mipmaps. Every body's UVs lie in [0.0029, 0.9971], so bilinear mip-0 sampling never leaves its tile.

Wounds / blood larger than maxHole on skin stay non-skin; skin-coloured blood stains / patches printed on baked cloth are removed only where enclosed in the cloth (courier, lastshift); a few px at the courier's tank-top hem remain.

scavenger: whether the pink, vein-mottled torso under its open jacket is bare skin or a flesh-toned torn shirt is ambiguous in the texture; it is treated as skin between the lapels (throat to belt) plus the hands; the gas-mask head, jacket, trousers and boots are never skin.
heavyset: the short beard stubble counts as skin (the colour tolerance that covers the darker shaved scalp includes it); eyes stay out.
Hair: dark / brown / blonde hair is excluded by colour; pale strands lying on skin and a thin line along some hairlines are approximate. Eyes and mouth interiors stay out where larger than maxHole.
Runtime garments (upper / lower slots) cover much of the body; the mask under them is irrelevant but harmless.
